definitions.explanation: The original published version of a book or other printed work. In book collecting, first editions can hold significant value. Composed of {初|しょ} (first) + {版|はん} (edition/printing).

examples.japanese: {初版|しょはん}は{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
この{本|ほん}の{初版|しょはん}は1985{年|ねん}に{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
examples.english: The first edition of this book was published in 1985.

examples.japanese: {初版|しょはん}{本|ぼん}は{古書店|こしょてん}で{高値|たかね}で{取引|とりひき}されることがある。
examples.english: First-edition books are sometimes traded at high prices in used bookstores.

notes:
USAGE:
{初版|しょはん} can refer to either the first edition (distinct version with changes) or the first printing (initial print run of the same content). In casual usage, the distinction is often blurred. {初版|しょはん}{本|ぼん} specifically means a first-edition copy of a book.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初版|しょはん}{本|ぼん} (first-edition copy)
- {初版|しょはん}{発行|はっこう} (first edition published)
- {初版|しょはん}{第一刷|だいいちずり} (first edition, first printing)

RELATED TERMS:
- {改訂版|かいていばん} means revised edition.
- {増補版|ぞうほばん} means expanded edition.
- {重版|じゅうはん} means additional printing or reprint.
- {絶版|ぜっぱん} means out of print.
